name: Neural Surfel Radiance Fields
definition: A variant of neural radiance field that employs a flexible and scalable neural surfel representation to store geometric attributes and extracted appearance features from input images, enabling efficient online reconstruction and high-quality rendering.
summary: Neural Surfel Radiance Fields is an online photorealistic reconstruction method that represents scenes as dynamic neural surfels, enabling real-time large-scale indoor scene reconstruction via differentiable rasterization.
